en.headline: White Audi reverses into four taxis while fleeing Tsim Sha Tsui roadblock
en.dek: Police said the driver of a white Audi hit four taxis after being signalled to stop early Tuesday, then fled against traffic; one taxi driver was taken to hospital.
body: Officers set up a roadblock outside St Andrew's Church at 138 Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui at about 1:15am on Tuesday. They signalled the driver of a white Audi to stop for checks.

The car suddenly reversed in an attempt to escape, striking four taxis before driving against the traffic flow into Hillwood Road and leaving the scene, police and witnesses said. One taxi driver reported back pain and was taken conscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

Video circulating online showed officers moving forward as the car reversed into the taxis, with people shouting for the driver to stop. A section of Nathan Road from Austin Road towards Tsim Sha Tsui was temporarily closed for investigation.
Police are investigating the incident, which occurred in the early hours of 17 November.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀私家車倒車撞四的士後逆線逃走
zh.dek: 警方指白色Audi司機周二凌晨被截停時突然倒車，撞向四輛的士後逆線逃去，一名的士司機送院。
body: 警方周二凌晨約1時15分在尖沙咀彌敦道138號聖安德烈堂對開設置路障，示意一輛白色Audi私家車停車接受調查。
該車突然倒車企圖逃走，先後撞向四輛的士，其後逆線駛入山林道離開現場。一名的士司機報稱腰痛，清醒送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。
網上流傳片段顯示，私家車倒車期間多名警員上前試圖截停，有人大聲喝止。彌敦道由柯士甸道往尖沙咀方向一段一度封閉，以便調查。
警方正調查事件，事發於11月17日凌晨。
